decisions.reason: Garage door operators are closely tied to the firm's core door business, and the dedicated product page signals strategic commitment, so the firm can readily learn from early results and improve the product.
The solid wood door relies partly on woodworking knowledge outside the firm's metal fabrication base, so it is a riskier niche, but it complements the garage door range and is likely kept for now.
The remote-control operator extends the operator line, where electronics knowledge can be absorbed through suppliers and partners, so it fits the existing portfolio.
A glazed industrial sectional door builds directly on existing sectional door and metal frame competence, so the firm can easily interpret and refine it.
The insulated glazed variant draws on established panel and insulation know-how and meets energy-efficiency demand, giving it a strong fit with the firm's knowledge.
This glazed industrial door has its own page, showing commitment, and lies at the firm's core competence.
